entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State, learned counsel for the informant and perused the material brought on record.

2. The second bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.619 of 2019,
under Sections - 376(C), 328, 342, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Bilahur, District- Kanpur Nagar with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It was submitted that ossification test of victim girl has not been conducted and that her alleged date of birth 15.01.2005 shown in the school certificate, is false and baseless.

The alleged incident has been shown of 05.01.2019 but FIR has been lodged on 10.12.2019 Lalu @ Govind vs State Of Up Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186366832/
1 in pursuance to order passed under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C.

entities.text: Lalu @ Govind vs State Of Up Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was submitted that in fact informant has taken loan of Rs. 1 lac from applicant about two years back and applicant was asking to return the same and that first information report of this case was lodged due to that reason.
The statement of victim girl recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., is false and tutored.

The victim was consenting party and that no offence is made out against the applicant.
4. It is further submitted that first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 30.07.2021 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.28530 of 2020 and after that statements of informant as well as of victim have been recorded before the trial Court.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.28530 of 2020
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Referring to statements of P.W.-1 (informant) and P.W. 2 (victim), it was submitted that there are material contradictions and infirmities in their statements.
It was stated that in school record, age of victim has been shown less and her ossification test has not been conducted.

Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 14.12.2019, and thus, he has already undergone the detention of about four and half years and there are number of formal witnesses, who are yet to be examined.
It was further submitted that applicant has no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.

5. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that victim is a minor girl aged about 15 years and she has made an allegation of rape against the applicant and that first bail application of applicant has already been rejected on merits.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant - Lalu @ Govind involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the Lalu @ Govind vs State Of Up Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186366832/
2 evidence.

entities.text: Lalu @ Govind vs State Of Up Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.
